# The IATA codes the boards can meet besides those in the board's own tables (CITY,
# CITY_FR, AP, AP_LIST, GATE_AP, COORDS, AIRPORT_COORDS, ZONE_LIST and the others):
# [recorded] the codes the live boards' rows were recorded with (the overnight sweep of
# every airport, its rechecks and reruns, and the live re-check of v24067, 2026-10-19);
# [ourairports scheduled] every airport with airline service and an IATA code;
# [ourairports medium and large] every other medium or large airport with an IATA code
# (charter and seasonal flights: Fort Resolution, Fort Liard, Wrigley on Yellowknife's
# board). OurAirports airports.csv, read 2026-10-19 (public domain). tests/earth-places.test.js
[recorded]
